# Planet Flight
Over a planet, your gravity generator does nothing. Your thrusters hold the ship up. The flight panel on the shuttle console shows whether they can.
## The flight panel
- The top line says what the ship is doing: in orbit, landed, lifting off, climbing, hovering, descending, or [color=#ff3030]LIFT LOST[/color]. - [bold]Lift[/bold] is thrust against the ship's weight on this planet. You need [color=#3fe05a]100%[/color] to hover, climb or take off. Under 100% the ship sinks. Under 50% it falls. - [bold]Power[/bold] says whether your grid can run every thruster. If it is short, thrusters cut out and lift drops. - When landed, the panel says [color=#3fe05a]READY FOR LIFTOFF[/color] or [color=#ff3030]NOT READY[/color], and why. - A [color=#ffd23f]Fix[/color] line tells you how many thrusters to convert or add, or how much power you are missing.
## Thrusters in atmosphere
- Ordinary thrusters give [bold]half thrust[/bold] below orbit. - Landing thrusters give [bold]full thrust[/bold]. Convert an anchored thruster with a landing thruster conversion kit, or have a drydock fit atmospheric thrusters to the whole ship. - Heavier planets need more lift. The ship previewer estimates the strongest gravity a ship can lift off in.
## Going down and coming back up
1. Fly to the planet and press [bold]Enter orbit[/bold]. 2. Check the panel. With 100% lift and enough power, hold [bold]descend[/bold] or press [bold]Enter atmosphere[/bold]. With less, the console asks you to confirm, because the ship will not be able to climb back out. 3. In the air, ascend and descend change altitude. Land gently. 4. To leave, hold [bold]ascend[/bold] or press [bold]Liftoff[/bold]. Keep climbing to reach orbit, then press [bold]Leave orbit[/bold].
## When it goes wrong
- A ship that loses lift glides down and the alarms call out its height. Restore power or thrust and it recovers. - Hitting the ground too fast is a crash: hull damage, a skid and broken systems. - Force-anchored ships and ships held by something on the ground cannot lift off. The panel says what is holding you.
